verdict.rationale: Pika documents an Upscale app that adds resolution to images and video, including low-resolution clips, which covers the 'upscale the chosen take' half of the story. The 'draft fast in a cheaper mode' half is only implied: the multi-model catalog includes a 'seedance-2.0-fast' playground and per-model catalog pricing, but there is no documented draft or preview tier. missing for 10: an explicit documented low-cost/fast draft mode, documentation of a draft-to-upscale workflow, evidence of final output quality after upscaling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality

citations.quote: Upscale: Add resolution to any image or video
Upload a low-resolution photo, clip or older footage and create a larger output for your next project.
Every generation runs against production at the price the catalog quotes, so price a request before running it.
